name: notchwake
title: Notchwake
description: Control the Notchwake island in your Mac's notch: open a tab, start a timer, keep the Mac awake and jot a note.
author: victorserpa

commands.name: open-island
commands.title: Open Island
commands.subtitle: Notchwake
commands.description: Open the island on a tab.

commands.name: start-timer
commands.title: Start Timer
commands.subtitle: Notchwake
commands.description: Start a countdown under the notch.

commands.name: keep-awake
commands.title: Keep Mac Awake
commands.subtitle: Notchwake
commands.description: Keep the Mac awake for some minutes, or type off to stop.

commands.name: add-note
commands.title: Add Note
commands.subtitle: Notchwake
commands.description: Append a line to the island's note.
